// diagnostic E0762

Jet.ContextFieldTypeMismatch

`#Context` field type mismatch (`allocator` must be an allocator handle or a `mem.Allocator` value)

What

`#Context` field type mismatch (`allocator` must be an allocator handle or a `mem.Allocator` value)

Why

Each context field holds one kind of value, so the code under it can rely on that type

Fix

Give each `#Context` field its required type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ContextFieldTypeMismatch: Tests/UI/context_wrong_type.stderr.

Error: Jet.ContextFieldTypeMismatch: `allocator` needs an allocator, got Int (a whole number)
  --> Tests/UI/context_wrong_type.jet:3:14
    |
  3 |     #Context(allocator: 42) { print("should not reach") }
    |              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The `allocator` field takes an `Arena`, `Bump`, `Pool`, or `Fixed` value, or a value whose type implements `mem.Allocator`
 Fix: Pass an allocator, e.g. `mem.Arena.new()`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.ContextFieldTypeMismatch
